Max often helps me with music. We often go to the gym together. I am happy every day. Also, only three students came early.
The front desk is big and clean. After school, we play together. Grace usually eats rice for lunch. In fact, the cat eats from a blue bowl.
Max likes rice too. I like my life very much. Grace's favorite subject is music.
